Jewelry Store Staff SOP: Transitioning from Handwritten to Mobile Computerized Bills

Quick Guide

1 Hardware Pairing (3-Inch Bluetooth Thermal Printer / Wi-Fi Printer)

To eliminate bulky PCs and counter cables, jewelry counter staff can print bills wirelessly directly from their Android or iPhone smartphones.

Option A: 80mm Bluetooth Thermal Slip Printer (Recommended)
  • Turn ON printer (e.g. TVS RP3200, NGX, Everycom 80mm).
  • Enable Bluetooth on smartphone & pair device (PIN usually 0000 or 1234).
  • On Android: Install free companion service RawBT Print Service or PrintHand so web pages can print via Bluetooth with 1 click.
  • On iOS: Pair via AirPrint or use Bluetooth thermal utility app.
Option B: Wi-Fi Laser / InkTank Printer (A4 / A5 Tax Invoices)
  • Connect printer (HP / Canon / Epson) to shop Wi-Fi network.
  • Connect staff phones to the same Wi-Fi.
  • Print directly via built-in AirPrint (iPhone) or Mopria Default Print Service (Android) without installing any third-party app!

2 Morning Opening Routine: Update Today's Metal Rates

Every morning when the shop opens, the head cashier or owner taps "Update Rates" in the top bar to set the daily 24K, 22K (916), 18K (750) Gold and Silver rates. All subsequent bills entered by staff will automatically calculate metal values based on these verified rates.

3 Counter Billing & Mandatory Jewelry Compliances

  • HUID Code: Ensure the 6-character BIS Hallmarking Unique Identification (e.g. AB1234) laser-marked on the jewelry piece is entered in the item row. This protects both the customer and the jeweler.
  • Gross vs Net Weight: Always record the gross weight from the digital scale and subtract stones/beads/wax to get the pure metal net weight.
  • Old Gold Exchange: If the customer exchanges old jewelry, tick the "Old Gold Exchange" section. Enter gross weight, melting deduction, and purity % to give transparent, accurate credit.
  • PAN / Aadhaar Requirement: In India, as per Income Tax Rule 114B, whenever an invoice exceeds ₹2,00,000, customer PAN/Aadhaar is legally mandatory. The app alerts you automatically when this threshold is crossed.

4 Zero-Wait Checkout: 1-Tap Print & WhatsApp Digital Copy

Once details are entered, tap "Preview & Print":

Paper Slip: Tap "Print Directly" to trigger the wireless printer. Hand the printed thermal slip or A4 tax invoice to the customer in their jewelry box.
Digital WhatsApp Bill: Tap "WhatsApp Bill" to instantly launch WhatsApp with the complete itemized bill pre-filled to the customer's phone number! Customers love this modern, eco-friendly touch.

5 Evening Closing & Record Reconciliation

At night, open the "Bill Records" tab. Tap "Export CSV" to download the day's sales register for your accountant or CA, ensuring complete matching of cash, UPI collections, and gold stock weights.

Native Smartphone Experience

Take SwarnaBill Outside the Launcher

Run SwarnaBill directly on staff smartphones with 0-second launch times, zero browser toolbars, full-screen touch keyboard support, and 100% offline billing.

1

Instant Phone App (PWA)

Zero technical setup. Adds an app icon directly to iPhone or Android home screen.

How to install:

• Android Chrome: Tap top-right 3 dots → tap "Install App" or "Add to Home screen".

• iPhone Safari: Tap Share icon at bottom → scroll down → tap "Add to Home Screen".

2

Shop Local Wi-Fi Server

Run on 1 counter laptop so all staff phones connect over Wi-Fi without using cellular data.

1-Command Setup:

python3 -m http.server 8080

Staff open your laptop IP (e.g. http://192.168.1.50:8080) on their phone and tap "Add to Home Screen".

3

Build Native Android .APK

Package as an installable `.apk` file for Android devices via pre-configured Capacitor setup.

Capacitor Build Included:

The downloaded bundle includes capacitor.config.json, manifest, and icons.

npm install && npx cap build android

Why Running Standalone is 10x Better for Staff:

⚡ Instant 0-Second Launch No waiting for remote web sessions or iframes to load. Cached directly on the phone's internal storage.
📱 True Full-Screen Layout Hides all browser URL bars and navigation clutter, giving staff maximum screen area for entering weights and HUIDs.
📴 100% Offline Resilience Even if shop internet disconnects, staff can continue calculating bills, creating invoices, and printing wirelessly.
